prompt:
INPUT: the attached image is the approved character — her Mecha card; keep her. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

CHARACTER: the same woman as the attached image — the female personification of Deng Ai of the Three Kingdoms, seen in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye and hair colors, haircut, skin tone and body proportions; expression and hair motion may change, and her hair may be worn differently only as SCENE's Hair line says. Her mecha-world identity shows ONLY as a small accessory, an object around her, or the object PROP says she holds — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume.

DESIGN (accessory hints only): her legend — a stutter and a brilliant mind for terrain, felt cloak, rope and climbing gear on her armor — may inform at most one small accessory, a hair ornament or an object beside her, in its palette (deep navy blue, black lacquer, cold steel silver, ivory white). The clothes keep the chosen outfit's own colours; her skin, hair and eyes stay as in the attached image.

STYLE: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

AGE: the same adult woman as in the attached image — keep her own face shape, cheekbones, eye proportions and skin tone exactly; minimal facial lines (no nasolabial folds, crow's feet, under-eye bags or cheek creases). Keep her face soft, feminine and attractive in every framing — never elongated, gaunt, mannish or heavy-jawed, even in close-ups, profiles or low angles.

OUTPUT: one standalone off-duty scene of her in the outfit chosen in SCENE; her legend shows only through accessories and objects around her — never in the outfit's colours, patterns or cut, never as armor, regalia or a costume. Everything else follows SCENE (chosen).

FRAME: a vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) image. Compose the image for this frame; COMPOSITION in SCENE sets how much of her shows.

ERA: a present-day place where the Three Kingdoms is remembered — a museum of Han relics, a restored plank road, the Red Cliffs park, an old city wall, a Chengdu teahouse, the Wuhou Shrine, a Guan Yu temple, Baidicheng, the Changban Bridge, a film set, an opera dressing room, a calligraphy class or a festival street.

SCENE (chosen):
Place: the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk, a stone railing along the bank, still water reflecting the battlements and willows
Hair: her hair in a single loose braid over one shoulder — same colour and length as the attached image.
Light direction: backlit — the main light comes from behind her, a bright rim along her hair and shoulders.
Outfit: grunge — an oversized plaid flannel tied at the waist over a slip dress and combat boots
POSTURE: walking.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters away from the camera; head turned back over her own left shoulder — the shoulder on the image's left side; camera slightly below, looking up at her; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left arm hangs relaxed at her side.
PROP: with her own right hand she carries a rolled-up felt blanket and a rope coil low at her side; it is all she holds.
SIGNATURE ITEM SHAPE: it is one whole object drawn once: a long weapon (spear, glaive, halberd, staff, bow) keeps a single straight, unbroken shaft from butt to head with exactly one head or blade, held in front of or beside her body — never passing behind her head or shoulders, never broken, bent, split in two by her body or arm, or duplicated; if the frame cuts it, it leaves the frame as one straight line.
LEGS: paused mid-walk, weight on the front foot.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: a soft faraway look with a faint wistful smile. Keep it subtle and natural, a light touch rather than acting: no sneer, glare, smirk-pulled cheek or chin lifted to look down at the viewer; her face stays relaxed and attractive. Her eyes are naturally open and clear, not heavy-lidded or half-closed; brows relaxed and even, neither raised on one side nor furrowed; lips softly closed or only just parted.
overall_intensity: strong — maximal styling presence within the scene; retain chosen exposure and anatomy
skin_exposure: bold — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered

WARDROBE: change her clothes completely. From the attached image take only her face, hair and body — not its garment, armor, regalia, ornaments, mecha plates or background. Dress her exactly as SCENE describes; that outfit must read at first glance, keeping its own recognisable colours and parts. Do not carry the attached image's palette, patterns or trim into the outfit; her mecha-world identity belongs in accessories and props, never in the clothes — never restyle the chosen outfit into her faction's palette, armor, robes or regalia.

ANGLE: the attached image fixes who she is, not how she is posed or shot. Do not copy its head angle, head tilt, gaze direction, face size in frame, camera height or crop — turn her head, set her gaze and place the camera exactly as SCENE describes, and let her face read naturally from that new angle (profile, three-quarter, looking down or away), with her features staying the same. No default card pose, no default front-facing portrait.

LOOK-BACK: her back is toward the camera and her head turns at most a quarter turn over one shoulder — the face shows in profile or three-quarter view, never full-front on a back-facing torso. Her chin sits just above the near shoulder, the far eye and cheek may be partly hidden, the side of the neck shows the turn and the shoulder line continues behind the head. Where her eyes go follows GAZE.

ONE MAIN FIGURE: she is the only character in focus. Where the place is busy, other people may appear only as small, soft-focus background extras — never posed with her. No logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border. No readable text or numbers.

ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, about 7.5 heads tall — height from the legs, never a smaller head or a longer neck. The neck is a natural length and the head sits close to the shoulders. No body-part enlargement, no extra limbs.

FIGURE: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; elbows, knees and wrists bend the human way. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose, what she holds or the frame. Right and left mean her own right and left, not the viewer's.

HANDS: natural human hands, no extra or duplicated limbs; each visible hand joins through its wrist and forearm to the matching shoulder. A hand may stay outside the crop, and fingers may be partly hidden by a grip.

AVOID: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
